candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because the downstream order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders; traces and logs show the gateway's client call to order failing with 500, propagating as 502 on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, payment, inventory) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are consistently paired with 500 responses from the order service on POST /v1/orders in traces and logs; gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200). The bounded cause is downstream order-service 500s; the order-internal fault is not yet established.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/traces showing the internal cause of its 500 responses
Order service metrics (error rate, latency, dependency outcomes)
Dependency telemetry for order's calls to postgresql, payment, inventory
